parsed.note_claim: El nuevo Lord Mayor de Leicester, Kulwinder Singh Johal, es sij y no musulmán.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Guided by his Sikh faith and the principle of seva (selfless service), he has volunteered for decades and is committed to serving every resident of Leicester with openness, respect and humility.
parsed.reason: The page explicitly identifies the Lord Mayor as Kulwinder Singh Johal and states he is guided by his Sikh faith, directly confirming the note's correction.
